title: The builder-diff guard judges an auto-committed strategy merge or pull
why: Lane tier-boundaries-enforced (session_013NEJKzVTWMbokJ3KFanBBC), relayed by the coordinator 13:51 CST Nov 8: builder-diff (hooks/guard.py, near builder_diff) reads only reflog entries for commit, amend, merge, initial, cherry-pick and revert. So an auto-committed `git merge -X ours|theirs` or `-s ours`, or a `git pull` with those options (reflog "merge <x>: ..."), is never judged at commit, push or stop. A builder that resolves a test conflict by strategy goes unjudged, against owner item 437 a. A builder could do it by mistake. The lane files the debt in #1904. Merge after #1904.
